## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass locally (CI also enforces 80 % coverage)
- [ ] New or changed behaviour is covered by tests (or this PR changes no behaviour)
- [ ] UI changes are checked at phone width (or this PR has no UI changes)
- [ ] Docs are updated where needed — README, CLAUDE.md, `docs/architecture.md` for room, turn and seat logic (or nothing to update)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, internal hostnames or personal data in code, commits, screenshots or logs
